items.headline: Canaccord Genuity Maintains Buy on Sharplink, Lowers Price Target to $8
items.summary: Canaccord Genuity  analyst Joseph Vafi   maintains Sharplink (NASDAQ:SBET) with a Buy and lowers the price target from $16 to $8.
